commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
90+8' Poor challenge! Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is penalised for tripping and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle.
90+5' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+3' Substitution. Aaron Zehnter is replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
90+3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is caught offside!
90+2' Oliver Baumann makes a brilliant save! Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.
90+2' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+1' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
89' The ball is cleared after Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
89' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
88' The goal by Hoffenheim is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
85' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Hoffenheim players aren’t happy.
84' Goal! Ozan Kabak connects with the free kick and heads it into the path of Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), who makes no mistake and puts it into the net. 2:4.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Grischa Promel walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
83' The attendance for today's match is 20078.
82' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:4.
79' Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
78' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
76' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
75' Paul Simonis has decided to substitute Christian Eriksen and he is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
75' A substitution has been made. Tim Lemperle is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
74' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
74' A long pass, executed by Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
71' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' The Wolfsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
66' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Frank Willenborg has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

65' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
63' Here comes a substitution. Bazoumana Toure is given a rest as he is replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).

62' 2 - 3 Grischa Promel is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:3.

61' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Oliver Baumann pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
60' Here is a change. Mattias Svanberg is going off and Paul Simonis gives the last tactical orders to Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
60' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.

59' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) tries to find Bazoumana Toure with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

56' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg). Sael Kumbedi plays a fantastic through ball and finds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the roof of the net. It's now 2:2.

55' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
54' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
53' Handball! A player from Hoffenheim handled the ball.
52' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off the line to clear the ball away.

50' 1 - 2 Andrej Kramaric showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:2.
48' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
48' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
46' Christian Ilzer has made a change at the break. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has come on in place of Fisnik Asllani.
46' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Albian Hajdari is replaced by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the right post.
45+1' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
45+1' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
44' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Referee Frank Willenborg sees the trip by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
42' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

41' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Frank Willenborg blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
39' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:2. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
36' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
35' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
34' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
33' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
31' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Vladimir Coufal laid the ball off to Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
31' Hoffenheim hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
29' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
29' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Hoffenheim as they win a corner.
29' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
28' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) trips an opposition player and Frank Willenborg signals a foul.
27' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
25' Kamil Grabara is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim). Easy save!
24' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

23' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) attempts to find Vladimir Coufal with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
18' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
17' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

14' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mattias Svanberg slips the ball through to Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), and he darts into the box to unleash a strong shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
13' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is penalised for holding. Frank Willenborg signals a set piece.
11' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
10' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
6' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
5' A clumsy foul by Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle.
4' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Hoffenheim was in an offside position.
